The 17 Best Zoom Cooking Classes in 2026

by: Megan Johnson
Share
Last Updated on Mar 26th 2026 | 0

Zoom cooking classes help us avoid that all-too-familiar disaster: After binge-watching cooking videos on YouTube, you finally attempt to recreate a recipe at home and it turns out...less than perfect. You’re left wishing you could ask the chef on screen for some pointers, but it’s not a live online cooking class; it’s just you and YouTube. 

There’s no reason to go it alone in the kitchen. Zoom cooking classes take the guesswork out of cooking and bring the chef to you, virtually. 

Live online cooking classes span a variety of cuisines and diets and bring an authentic cooking class experience into your personal kitchen. Although there are dozens to choose from, we’ve picked the 17 best Zoom cooking classes to try this year.

Taking Cooking Classes on Zoom

Zoom cooking classes are hosted live on video conferencing software and are taught by expert chefs. Taking a cooking class over Zoom is as simple as popping open your computer or smart device in your kitchen and cooking along with your chef. Online cooking classes are fully interactive, letting you ask all of the questions you want as your chef leads you through your lesson. 

Why You Should Take an Online Cooking Class

Online cooking classes incorporate all the benefits of a traditional cooking class from the comfort of your home kitchen. You could be following a recipe from one of the best cookbooks out there, but sometimes it's better to see live examples of the cooking rather than following pictures.

Because the classes are live, you’ll find them just as interactive as an in-person class. You can ask questions, show the chef how your dish is coming along and chat with classmates. 

In fact, online cooking classes are so interactive that you could even book your class with friends or coworkers for a creative, socially-distant night in or a much-needed team building activity. 

Taking a Zoom cooking class also allows you to learn from chefs outside your city. Expert chefs host classes live from around the world!

The 17 Best Zoom Cooking Classes

The live, online cooking classes hosted on Zoom bring all the elements of a live cooking class into your home kitchen! You’ll find classes for every cuisine and for every diet, from Italian classics to vegan cooking classes. Here are 17 of the best Zoom cooking classes.

Pasta-Making Zoom Cooking Classes

1. Homemade Fettuccine and Ravioli

In this online cooking class conducted in Rome, Italy, Chef Davide will teach you to make homemade fettuccine and ravioli as well as a flavorful tomato basil sauce.

Along the way, you’ll learn professional tips and tricks and even family kitchen secrets straight from Davide’s nonna. Once you get a taste for homemade pasta and sauce, you'll want to explore even more virtual Italian cooking classes.

This 90-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

2. Intro to Gnocchi

Learn to make fresh, pillowy gnocchi and savory San Marzano tomato sauce in this Zoom pasta-making class. You’ll learn the trick to making those sauce-catching ridges and how to perfectly season your sauce for rich flavor. 

This 90-minute class is $29 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

3. Mastering Pasta Carbonara

Live from Florence, Italy, learn to prepare fresh pasta carbonara from scratch in this online pasta-making class. Chef Stefano will teach you authentic Italian culinary techniques using high-quality ingredients. You’ll also prepare a decadent egg white chocolate cake for dessert.

This 75-minute class is $35 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

4. Pasta and Puccini

Combine two of Italy’s best exports — pasta and opera — into one unforgettable class. In this three-course online cooking class, you’ll be transported to the cafés of Italy with a mouthwatering panzanella salad, fresh fettuccine with lemon cream sauce and a decadent tiramisu. For even more romantically-inclined options, online cooking classes for couples provide plenty of inspiration.

This 150-minute class is $49 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

Zoom Cooking Classes for Beginners

5. Classic Chinese Dim Sum

In this interactive Zoom cooking class, you'll learn the secrets behind classic Chinese dim sum perfectly suited to beginners. You’ll master crispy char siu pork puffs, fried soy rolls and kailan — Chinese broccoli accented with oyster sauce and soy sauce. Online Chinese cooking classes make it easy to learn authentic regional cuisines such as Cantonese, Szechuan, Fujian, Anhui and beyond.

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

6. Pizza Di Napoli

Pizza is a weeknight dinner hero, and a simple culinary creation for beginners. In this Zoom cooking class, you’ll learn to make a Neapolitan-style pizza complete with deli meat, mushrooms, mozzarella, parsley and homemade dough. Then, transform your dough into something sweet with a cinnamon cream cheese pizza for dessert. Online cooking classes for beginners make it easy to get started in the kitchen.

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

7. Authentic Naan and Homemade Curry

In this beginner-friendly virtual cooking class, you’ll learn how to make a warm and comforting Indian cuisine: Chicken curry featuring the deep, rich flavor of garam masala. As the perfect accompaniment, you’ll also learn how to make homemade naan. Once you get the basics down, there are plenty more online Indian cooking classes to further refine your skills!

This 90-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

8. Health-Boosting Bites

Healthy cuisine can be beginner friendly thanks to this Zoom cooking class! You’ll learn how to cook up a multi-course healthy feast packed with nutritious, immunity-boosting ingredients. Your menu covers a refreshing spinach and honeyed walnut salad, Spanish braised chicken and turmeric toasted chickpeas. You can explore how wholesome homemade cuisine can be with even more online healthy cooking classes.

This 75-minute class is $29 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

Plant-Based Zoom Cooking Classes

9. Plant-Based Jackfruit Tacos

Learn about the versatility of jackfruit while you make vegan tacos in this Zoom cooking class. Jackfruit takes the place of carne asada but retains a satisfying flavor and texture, making it the perfect shredded meat alternative. You’ll also make a homemade guacamole and pineapple salsa to top your tacos. With online vegan cooking classes, you'll experience first-hand how deliciously diverse a vegan menu can be.

This 90-minute class is $29 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

10. Hummus and Falafel Festival

Master a Middle Eastern street food classic in this falafel and hummus virtual cooking class. The humble garbanzo bean takes center stage for a two-part meal that is every bit as nutritious as it is herbaceous, refreshing, savory and satisfying. 

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

11. Eggplant Carpaccio From Scratch

This Zoom cooking class combines plant-based, healthy and gluten-free cuisine into one beautiful eggplant carpaccio. Once you build your layers, you’ll top the whole creation off with a creamy tahini sauce. Online vegetarian cooking classes and online gluten-free cooking classes are the perfect way to plan meals for your dietary preferences.

This 75-minute class is $29 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

International Zoom Cooking Classes

12. Spanish Tapas Celebration

Create a traditional spread of Spanish tapas in this Zoom cooking class taught live from Madrid, Spain. In this class, you’ll learn how to make a classic omelet with potatoes and onions, Spanish toast with tomatoes and jamón Ibérico and gildas with anchovies, olives and guindilla peppers. 

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

13. Mexican-Italian Fusion Cuisine

Two iconic cuisines meet in the middle for this online cooking class. Taught live from Florence, Italy, this Mexican-Italian fusion class features an unforgettable menu of beef polenta tacos with beer onions, guacamole and spicy mayonnaise, followed by a black bean soufflé with Parmesan.

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

14. Street Food Favorites of Japan

Learn to create okonomiyaki, a savory Japanese pancake sold by street food vendors in Osaka, in this Zoom cooking class. Live from Tokyo, Japan, you’ll learn how to prepare this iconic dish, reminiscent of pizza, which you’ll top with bacon, egg, dashi and spring onions. You’ll also learn how to create okonomiyaki sauce and wakame seaweed soup. Online Japanese cooking classes and online Asian cooking classes offer an enticing array of menus that will elevate your culinary skills to new heights.

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

Dessert-Making Zoom Cooking Classes

15. Cake Creativity

In this Zoom cooking class, you’ll make a show-stopping sponge cake with mocha buttercream that is perfect for any birthday, celebration or special occasion. You’ll also learn how to assemble and decorate your cake so it looks as good as it tastes! If you've always wanted to perfect your talent for making gorgeous cakes, online cake decorating classes and online cake baking classes are a great place to start.

This 75-minute class is $29 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

16. Picture-Perfect Ice Cream

Learn to make two kinds of gourmet ice cream in this online cooking class — no ice cream maker required! You’ll go through the process of creating this creamy confection at home as you create two dynamic flavors: PB and J swirl and chocolate banana rocky road. You’ll also learn to create the perfect ice cream toppings, including a gooey salted caramel syrup, or fillings for Japanese-inspired desserts like mochi. 

This 75-minute class is $39 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

17. Tiramisu Doppio

Bring a touch of classic Italian elegance to the dessert table with this Zoom cooking class that teaches tiramisu two ways. First, you’ll get to make and enjoy a classic tiramisu with a bold coffee flavor and silky zabaglione filling. Then, tackle something out of the ordinary with a stunning strawberry basil tiramisu. Online pastry classes and online baking classes offer plenty of inspiration to jazz up your dessert recipe rotation.

This 90-minute class is $35 per device. Ingredients can be adapted for dietary restrictions or lack of availability.

FAQs

How do you do an online cooking class?

To participate in an online cooking class, all you need is an internet connection, a laptop or tablet, and the ingredients listed in the cooking class description. After you book your class, you’ll receive a booking confirmation in your email inbox with a Zoom link for your class. At your chosen cooking class time, you will click that Zoom link and join the class virtually from your home kitchen.

How long is an online cooking class?

Online cooking classes vary from 75 to 140 minutes in length. To find out how long your Zoom cooking class is, check the event duration in the “Details” section of your cooking class listing on Classpop!

How do online cooking classes work?

Online cooking classes work similarly to in-person classes. Once you join the class via the link sent to your email in your booking confirmation, you will be greeted by the chef and class will begin. 

The chef will ensure sure you have your materials assembled and give an overview of the flow of the class. Then, you’ll get cooking! The chef will guide you through each recipe step-by-step, leaving plenty of room for questions. You can interact with the chef and other participants or just cook away with your device camera turned off, if you prefer!

Are online cooking classes worth it?

Online cooking classes hosted by live chefs offer the same exposure to new dishes, cooking techniques and conversation as traditional cooking classes. Because the classes are hosted over Zoom, you can interact with the chef and other participants in real-time, just as you can in an in-person class. The chef can even see your dish and provide personalized pointers! 

Whether a vegan class has caught your eye or you can’t wait to attend an authentic pasta-making class, try your hand at one of the 17 Zoom cooking classes above and discover just how engaging and informative a live, online cooking class can be. You’ll finish class with a full belly and a full repertoire of kitchen tricks. 

For even more fun online cooking classes, check out other offerings on Classpop!
